build_quantizable_mixin: build a Haiku module that mixes in QuantizableMixin for quantization and rate computation
create_quantize_at_step: create a function that quantizes a JAX array at a given quantization step size
compute_laplace_rate: compute the entropy coding rate of a quantized array under a Laplace distribution
estimate_laplace_scale: estimate the scale parameter of a zero-mean Laplace distribution from sample data
get_quantized_masked_flattened_params: get the quantized masked and flattened parameters of a Haiku module for entropy coding
